name: MCP
note: Model Context Protocol, tools and resources
summary: An open protocol that connects LLM applications (hosts and their clients) to servers that expose tools, resources and prompts, using JSON-RPC 2.0 messages. It was introduced by Anthropic and donated in December 2025 to the Agentic AI Foundation, a directed fund under the Linux Foundation. The 2026-07-28 spec made the core stateless and moved Tasks into an extension.
facts: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio or Streamable HTTP
goodFor: Giving one agent access to many tools and data sources
Reusing integrations across hosts such as ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code
watchOut: Tool descriptions are untrusted input; prompt injection is a real risk
2026-07-28 spec deprecates Roots, Sampling, Logging and HTTP+SSE
